svg.title: The fly memory filter against the best conventional method, by memory budget
svg.desc: Top: the fly Bloom filter's score minus the best conventional method's, per dataset, at 3, 10, 30 and 100 bits per stored item; mostly above zero at 3 and 10 bits and mostly below at 30 and 100. Bottom: the share of familiar items each method misses when false alarms are held to 1%; at 10 bits and below no method misses fewer than 83.9%.
svg.text: 1 · Fly filter's score minus the best conventional method's

Fly odours, 10 bits: +0.021
Fly odours, 30 bits: −0.192
Fly odours, 100 bits: −0.172

svg.text: Filled: reliably different from zero. Hollow: the range includes zero.
